summary_en: 70,000 shares, ¥100M upper limit, 3.35% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Acquisition period 12 Aug 2026–31 Jul 2027. Method: open-market purchase on ToSTNeT-3. Stated purpose: strategic capital allocation, M&A deployment, and execution of near-term investment aligned with ¥10B sales target by Sep 2030.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On 10 August 2026, Bridge Consulting Group's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 70,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 3.35% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury). The acquisition will cost up to ¥100 million and will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (ToSTNeT-3) during the period from 12 August 2026 to 31 July 2027.

The company states the purpose as flexible capital allocation in line with current stock price and financial conditions, and deployment for M&A activity. The initiative is framed within the company's growth strategy targeting ¥10 billion in sales by September 2030 and the execution of supporting investments to enhance enterprise value. At the date of resolution, the company held 92,200 treasury shares and had 2,089,000 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
